selected_probe.purpose: Compare early unforced target-liquid heating/relaxation at dt and dt/2; also audit saved pre-kick and post-kick velocity channels. This is a transient diagnostic, not a qualification run.
selected_probe.interpretation_rule: A similar large peak and decay supports initialization-driven heating over a dominant time-step cause of that transient; late equilibrium bias remains unverified. One different-dt random path is not an independent repeated estimate.
selected_probe.initial_state_rule: Same pinned library, Uniform particle name/rank/domain/density and Python velocity seed as the old equilibrium task; save new actual initial state. Old t=0 positions were not saved, so direct cross-run initial hashes are unavailable.
selected_probe.stop_conditions: Original shared-budget watchdog, nonfinite state, invalid particle count, or completed fixed steps. Partial results never imply completed discrimination.
selected_probe.why_still_informative: It spans the observed heating peak and substantial decay, so it tests transient time-step dependence without repeating an inadequate qualification attempt.
